units.id: mission:Raider returning to Mordente-Bridi|Watching the microgravity section of the spaceport from one of the bars in Mordente Cylinder, you observe a Bastion in pirate markings coming nearly too fast for safe approach to the station, its hull covered in gashes and burns from what looks to be Plasma Cannon shots.|819|0
units.english: Watching the microgravity section of the spaceport from one of the bars in Mordente Cylinder, you observe a Bastion in pirate markings coming nearly too fast for safe approach to the station, its hull covered in gashes and burns from what looks to be Plasma Cannon shots.
units.italian: Osservando la sezione a microgravità dello spazioporto da uno dei bar del Cilindro Mordente, vedi un Bastion con i contrassegni dei pirati che arriva quasi troppo veloce per un avvicinamento sicuro alla stazione, con lo scafo coperto di squarci e bruciature che sembrano da colpi di cannone al plasma.

units.id: mission:Raider returning to Mordente-Bridi|	As it comes to a stop in a maintenance bay, the spaceport's engineering shuttles appear from all over and begin buzzing around the Bastion, assessing the damage and beginning the work on repairs. Meanwhile, its crew disperse from the ship and immediately begin unloading a multitude of busted-up crates and containers from the hold, probably raided from a civilian transport. It looks like their haul was worth the damage.|820|0
units.english: As it comes to a stop in a maintenance bay, the spaceport's engineering shuttles appear from all over and begin buzzing around the Bastion, assessing the damage and beginning the work on repairs. Meanwhile, its crew disperse from the ship and immediately begin unloading a multitude of busted-up crates and containers from the hold, probably raided from a civilian transport. It looks like their haul was worth the damage.
units.italian: Quando si ferma in una baia di manutenzione, gli shuttle tecnici dello spazioporto spuntano da ogni parte e cominciano a ronzargli intorno, valutando i danni e iniziando le riparazioni. Intanto l'equipaggio si disperde dalla nave e comincia subito a scaricare dalla stiva una moltitudine di casse e container ammaccati, probabilmente razziati da un trasporto civile. Sembra che il bottino valesse il danno.

units.id: mission:Raider returning to Mordente-Bridi|	Within the hour the work shuttles scatter from the ship as they finish patching up its battered hull, and the Bastion maneuvers out of the bay almost as haphazardly as it did when it entered.|821|0
units.english: Within the hour the work shuttles scatter from the ship as they finish patching up its battered hull, and the Bastion maneuvers out of the bay almost as haphazardly as it did when it entered.
units.italian: Nel giro di un'ora gli shuttle tecnici si disperdono dalla nave dopo aver finito di rattopparne lo scafo malconcio, e il Bastion esce dalla baia quasi con la stessa disinvoltura con cui era entrato.

units.id: mission:Militia returning to Solace|Wandering around the main spaceport on Solace, you notice several rows of shiny new landing pads next to the Delta V company offices. A large banner announces that you are witnessing the grand opening of Delta V's new private spaceport, and a crowd of interested spectators has gathered near the perimeter of the fence.|830|0
units.english: Wandering around the main spaceport on Solace, you notice several rows of shiny new landing pads next to the Delta V company offices. A large banner announces that you are witnessing the grand opening of Delta V's new private spaceport, and a crowd of interested spectators has gathered near the perimeter of the fence.
units.italian: Girando per lo spazioporto principale di Solace, noti diverse file di piattaforme di atterraggio nuove di zecca accanto agli uffici della Delta V. Un grande striscione annuncia che stai assistendo alla grande inaugurazione del nuovo spazioporto privato della Delta V, e una folla di curiosi si è radunata vicino al perimetro della recinzione.

units.id: mission:Militia returning to Solace|	Suddenly an Argosy comes streaking out of the sky, almost crashing into several smaller ships in the main spaceport before swerving out of sight behind a hangar in the direction of the new landing pads. There are shouts from the throng of onlookers, who all seem to think this was a stunt. Your more practiced eye, however, tells you that there are bullet marks on the Argosy's hull from a Gatling Gun. It was probably a miscalculation by the pilot's computer that almost caused the collision.|831|0
units.english: Suddenly an Argosy comes streaking out of the sky, almost crashing into several smaller ships in the main spaceport before swerving out of sight behind a hangar in the direction of the new landing pads. There are shouts from the throng of onlookers, who all seem to think this was a stunt. Your more practiced eye, however, tells you that there are bullet marks on the Argosy's hull from a Gatling Gun. It was probably a miscalculation by the pilot's computer that almost caused the collision.
units.italian: All'improvviso un Argosy sfreccia dal cielo, quasi schiantandosi contro diverse navi più piccole nello spazioporto principale prima di scomparire dietro un hangar in direzione delle nuove piattaforme. Dalla folla dei curiosi arrivano grida: sembrano tutti convinti che fosse un numero acrobatico. Il tuo occhio più esperto però ti dice che sullo scafo dell'Argosy ci sono segni di proiettili da mitragliatrice Gatling. Probabilmente è stato un errore di calcolo del computer del pilota a causare quasi la collisione.

units.id: mission:Militia returning to Solace|	Soon afterwards, an announcement is made from a large speaker, telling bystanders that nothing bad happened and that they can go home now. After staying for a while out of curiosity, the crowd finally disperses. However, you stick around and notice the Argosy flying back into view to land in the main spaceport.|832|0
units.english: Soon afterwards, an announcement is made from a large speaker, telling bystanders that nothing bad happened and that they can go home now. After staying for a while out of curiosity, the crowd finally disperses. However, you stick around and notice the Argosy flying back into view to land in the main spaceport.
units.italian: Poco dopo un annuncio da un grande altoparlante dice agli astanti che non è successo niente di male e che possono tornare a casa. Dopo essere rimasta un po' per curiosità, la folla si disperde. Tu però resti e vedi l'Argosy tornare in vista per atterrare nello spazioporto principale.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|News headlines bombard your comms as you land on <origin>: today is the three hundredth anniversary of the Republic. A crowd has gathered in the local spaceport in something of a celebration as they tune in to the main news stations, websites, and blogs throughout human space that are commenting on this momentous day. However, you notice many passersby moving about with an air of disdain for the festivities, simply trying to get their business here over quickly, and being frustrated at the inevitable slowness of the local facilities today.|844|0
units.english: News headlines bombard your comms as you land on <origin>: today is the three hundredth anniversary of the Republic. A crowd has gathered in the local spaceport in something of a celebration as they tune in to the main news stations, websites, and blogs throughout human space that are commenting on this momentous day. However, you notice many passersby moving about with an air of disdain for the festivities, simply trying to get their business here over quickly, and being frustrated at the inevitable slowness of the local facilities today.
units.italian: I titoli delle notizie ti bombardano le comunicazioni mentre atterri su <origin>: oggi è il trecentesimo anniversario della Repubblica. Una folla si è radunata nello spazioporto locale in una specie di festeggiamento, sintonizzata sulle principali stazioni, sui siti e sui blog di tutto lo spazio umano che commentano questa giornata memorabile. Noti però molti passanti che si muovono con aria di disprezzo per i festeggiamenti, cercando solo di sbrigare le proprie faccende e irritati dall'inevitabile lentezza delle strutture locali oggi.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	Originally formed by Earth and planets close to it, the Rim, and a few Dirt Belt worlds, the Republic went on to gradually expand and incorporate the Syndicate, Paradise Worlds, and the Deep. For three hundred years now, most of humanity has existed under its flag, and through protests and the space renaissance, waves of colonization, expansion, and battles against remnants of the Alphas, that flag remains flying over most human worlds today.|845|0
units.english: Originally formed by Earth and planets close to it, the Rim, and a few Dirt Belt worlds, the Republic went on to gradually expand and incorporate the Syndicate, Paradise Worlds, and the Deep. For three hundred years now, most of humanity has existed under its flag, and through protests and the space renaissance, waves of colonization, expansion, and battles against remnants of the Alphas, that flag remains flying over most human worlds today.
units.italian: Formata in origine dalla Terra e dai pianeti vicini, dal Bordo e da alcuni mondi della Cintura di Terra, la Repubblica si è poi progressivamente espansa incorporando il Sindacato, i Mondi del Paradiso e il Deep. Da trecento anni ormai la maggior parte dell'umanità vive sotto la sua bandiera, e tra proteste e rinascimento spaziale, ondate di colonizzazione, espansione e battaglie contro i resti degli Alfa, quella bandiera sventola ancora oggi su quasi tutti i mondi umani.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	Not all is well, of course, as the bombing of Geminus and Martini appears to have set the Republic on the precipice of war with the Free Worlds, in the southern portion of human space. You can't help but feel that much of the cheerfulness about this date has more to do with the national holiday than with a deep-rooted appreciation for the Republic's history and what it stands for.|851|0
units.english: Not all is well, of course, as the bombing of Geminus and Martini appears to have set the Republic on the precipice of war with the Free Worlds, in the southern portion of human space. You can't help but feel that much of the cheerfulness about this date has more to do with the national holiday than with a deep-rooted appreciation for the Republic's history and what it stands for.
units.italian: Non tutto va bene, naturalmente: il bombardamento di Geminus e Martini sembra aver portato la Repubblica sull'orlo della guerra con le Free Worlds, nella parte meridionale dello spazio umano. Non puoi fare a meno di pensare che buona parte dell'allegria per questa data abbia più a che vedere con la festa nazionale che con un apprezzamento profondo della storia della Repubblica e di ciò che rappresenta.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|label|853|0
units.english: war ongoing
units.italian: war ongoing

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	The ongoing war with the Free Worlds has greatly diminished what the Republic Department of Arts and Culture no doubt hoped to turn into the public event of the year. Local workers and merchant captains alike whisper among themselves, Navy personnel march to and from warships that come and go at an alarming rate, seemingly unfazed by the historical date, and some bar fights break out between likely inebriated local patriots and those reckless enough to voice their support for the Free Worlds here.|854|0
units.english: The ongoing war with the Free Worlds has greatly diminished what the Republic Department of Arts and Culture no doubt hoped to turn into the public event of the year. Local workers and merchant captains alike whisper among themselves, Navy personnel march to and from warships that come and go at an alarming rate, seemingly unfazed by the historical date, and some bar fights break out between likely inebriated local patriots and those reckless enough to voice their support for the Free Worlds here.
units.italian: La guerra in corso con le Free Worlds ha ridotto molto quello che il Dipartimento dell'Arte e della Cultura della Repubblica sperava senza dubbio di trasformare nell'evento pubblico dell'anno. Operai locali e capitani mercantili sussurrano tra loro, il personale della Marina marcia avanti e indietro verso navi da guerra che vanno e vengono a un ritmo allarmante, apparentemente indifferente alla data storica, e in qualche bar scoppiano risse tra locali patrioti probabilmente ubriachi e chi è tanto imprudente da esprimere qui il proprio sostegno alle Free Worlds.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|label|856|0
units.english: war over
units.italian: war over

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	The recent Free Worlds war seemed to threaten this long history of stability, as battles raged over the skies of dozens of planets, and the threat of an open nuclear war loomed closer as the conflict escalated. The indiscriminate disappearance of many systems close to Earth, followed by the unified human front against the Pug invaders, seems to have knit together the sentiments of many throughout the Republic - for the time being, at least.|857|0
units.english: The recent Free Worlds war seemed to threaten this long history of stability, as battles raged over the skies of dozens of planets, and the threat of an open nuclear war loomed closer as the conflict escalated. The indiscriminate disappearance of many systems close to Earth, followed by the unified human front against the Pug invaders, seems to have knit together the sentiments of many throughout the Republic - for the time being, at least.
units.italian: La recente guerra con le Free Worlds sembrava minacciare questa lunga storia di stabilità: le battaglie infuriavano nei cieli di decine di pianeti e la minaccia di una guerra nucleare aperta si faceva più vicina man mano che il conflitto cresceva. La sparizione indiscriminata di molti sistemi vicino alla Terra, seguita dal fronte umano unito contro gli invasori Pug, sembra aver ricucito i sentimenti di molti nella Repubblica, almeno per ora.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|label|862|0
units.english: zenith bombed
units.italian: zenith bombed

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	Dimming the mood of the otherwise mostly positive news titles are the comments about a mysterious armada of robotic warships invading the Far North. Having crushed the Navy forces over Farpoint, the fleet was only partially beaten after the detonation of a terrible bomb on Zenith, which wrecked much of the planet. Indeed, it was weeks still before the scattered ships were fully destroyed, and confidence in the Navy's - and, by extension, the Republic's - ability to keep humanity safe seems to have been affected significantly...|863|0
units.english: Dimming the mood of the otherwise mostly positive news titles are the comments about a mysterious armada of robotic warships invading the Far North. Having crushed the Navy forces over Farpoint, the fleet was only partially beaten after the detonation of a terrible bomb on Zenith, which wrecked much of the planet. Indeed, it was weeks still before the scattered ships were fully destroyed, and confidence in the Navy's - and, by extension, the Republic's - ability to keep humanity safe seems to have been affected significantly...
units.italian: Ad abbassare l'umore dei titoli per il resto per lo più positivi ci sono i commenti su una misteriosa armata di navi da guerra robotiche che invade il Nord Lontano. Dopo aver schiacciato le forze della Marina su Farpoint, la flotta è stata battuta solo in parte dopo la detonazione di una bomba terribile su Zenith, che ha devastato buona parte del pianeta. Ci sono volute settimane prima che le navi disperse fossero distrutte del tutto, e la fiducia nella capacità della Marina, e per estensione della Repubblica, di tenere al sicuro l'umanità sembra esserne stata toccata in modo significativo...

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|label|865|0
units.english: sestor beaten at farpoint
units.italian: sestor beaten at farpoint

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	Web comments and news anchors seem to be particularly excited to comment on the recent victory of the Navy over the mysterious armada of robotic warships that invaded the Far North. Though at a great cost to the northern fleet garrisons, the invading fleets were successfully stopped at the Farpoint base, preventing the ships from causing any further harm. Veterans of the Farpoint battle seem to be hoarding the spotlight, giving emotional reports of their memory of the fight, and of the sacrifices they went through to achieve victory.|866|0
units.english: Web comments and news anchors seem to be particularly excited to comment on the recent victory of the Navy over the mysterious armada of robotic warships that invaded the Far North. Though at a great cost to the northern fleet garrisons, the invading fleets were successfully stopped at the Farpoint base, preventing the ships from causing any further harm. Veterans of the Farpoint battle seem to be hoarding the spotlight, giving emotional reports of their memory of the fight, and of the sacrifices they went through to achieve victory.
units.italian: I commenti sul web e i conduttori delle notizie sembrano particolarmente entusiasti di commentare la recente vittoria della Marina sulla misteriosa armata di navi robotiche che ha invaso il Nord Lontano. A un costo elevato per le guarnigioni della flotta settentrionale, le flotte invasori sono state fermate alla base di Farpoint, impedendo alle navi di fare altri danni. I veterani della battaglia di Farpoint sembrano monopolizzare le luci della ribalta, con resoconti emozionati del loro ricordo dello scontro e dei sacrifici affrontati per ottenere la vittoria.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	(Join the celebration of the Republic's 300th anniversary.)|869|0
units.english: (Join the celebration of the Republic's 300th anniversary.)
units.italian: (Unisciti ai festeggiamenti per il trecentesimo anniversario della Repubblica.)

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	(Go on about my day as usual.)|871|0
units.english: (Go on about my day as usual.)
units.italian: (Vai avanti con la mia giornata come al solito.)

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	You switch your media channels off from the celebrations, and get to your ship's system checks. Once you're done, you prepare for just another day.|872|0
units.english: You switch your media channels off from the celebrations, and get to your ship's system checks. Once you're done, you prepare for just another day.
units.italian: Chiudi i canali media sui festeggiamenti e ti dedichi ai controlli dei sistemi della nave. Quando hai finito, ti prepari a un'altra giornata qualunque.

units.id: mission:Republic 300 Year Anniversary|	You take an hour or two to join in on the festivities, because after all, it's not everyone who can claim to have witnessed a centenary anniversary of a nation. Stepping off the <ship>, you head to the spaceport, have a couple of drinks, speak to some of the locals, and party with a few revelers. Once it's getting late, you head back to your ship and reflect on the meaning of this day throughout human space.|875|0
units.english: You take an hour or two to join in on the festivities, because after all, it's not everyone who can claim to have witnessed a centenary anniversary of a nation. Stepping off the <ship>, you head to the spaceport, have a couple of drinks, speak to some of the locals, and party with a few revelers. Once it's getting late, you head back to your ship and reflect on the meaning of this day throughout human space.
units.italian: Ti prendi un'ora o due per unirti ai festeggiamenti, perché dopotutto non tutti possono dire di aver visto l'anniversario centenario di una nazione. Scendendo dalla <ship>, vai allo spazioporto, bevi un paio di bicchieri, parli con alcuni locali e fai festa con qualche altro. Quando si fa tardi, torni alla nave e rifletti sul significato di questa giornata in tutto lo spazio umano.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|You wander the planet's sun-bleached boardwalk, passing dozens of rum-soaked bars. Eventually, you see a cramped restaurant squeezed between a closed souvenir shop and yet another bar. The building is painted coral with a battered tin awning, and a hand-written board dangles above the door with the words "Fresh Delish Dish Fish."|887|0
units.english: You wander the planet's sun-bleached boardwalk, passing dozens of rum-soaked bars. Eventually, you see a cramped restaurant squeezed between a closed souvenir shop and yet another bar. The building is painted coral with a battered tin awning, and a hand-written board dangles above the door with the words "Fresh Delish Dish Fish."
units.italian: Passeggi sul lungomare sbiancato dal sole del pianeta, passando davanti a decine di bar impregnati di rum. Alla fine vedi un ristorante angusto incastrato tra un negozio di souvenir chiuso e l'ennesimo bar. L'edificio è dipinto color corallo e ha una pensilina di lamiera ammaccata, e sopra la porta pende un cartello scritto a mano con le parole "Pesce Piatto Fresco e Squisito".

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	A lanky waiter with a braided silver beard and cybernetic left eye aggressively waves you in and gives a practiced yell: "Best Dish Fish in town! Once-in-a-lifetime experience, plus a worlds-renowned souvenir! Try the Dish Fish - the fish that's a dish!"|888|0
units.english: A lanky waiter with a braided silver beard and cybernetic left eye aggressively waves you in and gives a practiced yell: "Best Dish Fish in town! Once-in-a-lifetime experience, plus a worlds-renowned souvenir! Try the Dish Fish - the fish that's a dish!"
units.italian: Un cameriere allampanato con una barba argentata intrecciata e l'occhio sinistro cibernetico ti fa cenno con insistenza di entrare e lancia un grido ben esercitato: "Il miglior Pesce Piatto della città! Esperienza irripetibile, più un souvenir famoso in tutto il mondo! Prova il Pesce Piatto: il pesce che è un piatto!"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"What?"|890|0
units.english: "What?"
units.italian: "Cosa?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"How much?"|891|0
units.english: "How much?"
units.italian: "Quanto costa?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"No thanks."|893|0
units.english: "No thanks."
units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"Dish Fish! It's a fish that's a dish. Buccaneer Bay's famous for 'em." The waiter glares at you in mild annoyance. "It's a flat fish with a big head. The skull's flat and has three horns so it stands on its own as a plate, and we cook the rest of the fish to serve on it. You can keep the skull as a plate after. Dish. Fish."|895|0
units.english: "Dish Fish! It's a fish that's a dish. Buccaneer Bay's famous for 'em." The waiter glares at you in mild annoyance. "It's a flat fish with a big head. The skull's flat and has three horns so it stands on its own as a plate, and we cook the rest of the fish to serve on it. You can keep the skull as a plate after. Dish. Fish."
units.italian: "Pesce Piatto! È un pesce che è un piatto. Buccaneer Bay è famosa per questi." Il cameriere ti fulmina con un fastidio moderato. "È un pesce piatto con una testa grande. Il cranio è piatto e ha tre corna, quindi sta in piedi da solo come un piatto, e il resto del pesce lo cuciniamo per servirlo lì sopra. Il cranio te lo puoi tenere come piatto. Piatto. Pesce."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	The waiter puts a hand on your shoulder. "Only 99 credits, what a deal! The skull alone'll cost ya 200 credits anywhere else. What'ya say, want the meal of a lifetime?"|897|0
units.english: The waiter puts a hand on your shoulder. "Only 99 credits, what a deal! The skull alone'll cost ya 200 credits anywhere else. What'ya say, want the meal of a lifetime?"
units.italian: Il cameriere ti mette una mano sulla spalla. "Solo 99 crediti, che affare! Il cranio da solo costerebbe 200 crediti ovunque. Che ne dici, vuoi il pasto di una vita?"

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"Sure."|899|0
units.english: "Sure."
units.italian: "Certo."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"No thanks."|900|0
units.english: "No thanks."
units.italian: "No, grazie."

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	"Great! Service fee's included." The waiter snatches your credits, slaps a laminated menu and receipt into your hands, and shoves you into a cramped booth before hurrying away towards the kitchen. You look at the receipt to find that you've been charged 20 credits for a 'seating fee,' 30 credits for a 'convenience fee,' 50 credits for 'fish cleaning,' 80 credits for 'dish assembly,' and 100 credits for a 'service charge' - a total of 379 credits.|904|0
units.english: "Great! Service fee's included." The waiter snatches your credits, slaps a laminated menu and receipt into your hands, and shoves you into a cramped booth before hurrying away towards the kitchen. You look at the receipt to find that you've been charged 20 credits for a 'seating fee,' 30 credits for a 'convenience fee,' 50 credits for 'fish cleaning,' 80 credits for 'dish assembly,' and 100 credits for a 'service charge' - a total of 379 credits.
units.italian: "Perfetto! Il costo del servizio è incluso." Il cameriere ti strappa i crediti, ti sbatte in mano un menù plastificato e uno scontrino, e ti spinge in un box angusto prima di correre via verso la cucina. Guardi lo scontrino e scopri che ti hanno addebitato 20 crediti per il 'posto a sedere', 30 per 'servizio di comodità', 50 per 'pulizia del pesce', 80 per 'montaggio del piatto' e 100 per 'oneri di servizio': un totale di 379 crediti.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	Seated inside, the restaurant is even tighter than it looked from outdoors. There's a single row of tiny tables, a low ceiling, and a handful of other patrons who look like clueless tourists. The menu itself covers seafood and sea-adjacent food like Nine-Eye Pie, Hand-Mashed Helmet, Hydrozoan Lasanga, and a suspiciously named 'Captain's Catch.' The top of the menu has a headline dish written in sloppy cursive with a prominent infobox beneath taking up a full third of the menu:|905|0
units.english: Seated inside, the restaurant is even tighter than it looked from outdoors. There's a single row of tiny tables, a low ceiling, and a handful of other patrons who look like clueless tourists. The menu itself covers seafood and sea-adjacent food like Nine-Eye Pie, Hand-Mashed Helmet, Hydrozoan Lasanga, and a suspiciously named 'Captain's Catch.' The top of the menu has a headline dish written in sloppy cursive with a prominent infobox beneath taking up a full third of the menu:
units.italian: Seduto dentro, il ristorante è ancora più stretto di quanto sembrasse da fuori. C'è un'unica fila di tavolini, un soffitto basso e una manciata di altri clienti che sembrano turisti spaesati. Il menù stesso copre pesce e cibo affine al mare come la Torta Nove Occhi, l'Elmo Pestato a Mano, la Lasagna Idrozoica e un 'Pescato del Capitano' dal nome sospetto. In cima al menù c'è un piatto in evidenza scritto in un corsivo sciatto, con sotto un riquadro vistoso che occupa un terzo dell'intero menù:

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|		Dish Fish: Natural Wonder and Souvenir - 99 credits|907|0
units.english: Dish Fish: Natural Wonder and Souvenir - 99 credits
units.italian: Pesce Piatto: meraviglia naturale e souvenir - 99 crediti

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|		(additional fees not included)|908|0
units.english: (additional fees not included)
units.italian: (oneri aggiuntivi non inclusi)

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|			- The oceans of Buccaneer Bay are full of jawless, fish-like creatures commonly known as Buccaneer Bay Boneheads that have a single, bone-like plate over their head and body, an oversized skull!|909|0
units.english: - The oceans of Buccaneer Bay are full of jawless, fish-like creatures commonly known as Buccaneer Bay Boneheads that have a single, bone-like plate over their head and body, an oversized skull!
units.italian: - Gli oceani di Buccaneer Bay sono pieni di creature senza mascelle simili a pesci, comunemente note come Teste d'Osso di Buccaneer Bay, che hanno una singola placca ossea sopra la testa e il corpo, un cranio sovradimensionato!

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|			- Ecologically, they are commonly filter feeders, deposit feeders, and grazers, consuming tiny organisms or detritus from the water, sediment, or ocean floor.|910|0
units.english: - Ecologically, they are commonly filter feeders, deposit feeders, and grazers, consuming tiny organisms or detritus from the water, sediment, or ocean floor.
units.italian: - Dal punto di vista ecologico sono per lo più filtratori, detritivori e brucatori, che consumano piccoli organismi o detriti dall'acqua, dal sedimento o dal fondo oceanico.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|			- Dish Fish differ from other Buccaneer Bay Boneheads: they have a nearly perfectly circular head-plate, three small horns to fend off predators, and no eyes because they live on deep, low-light ocean floors.|911|0
units.english: - Dish Fish differ from other Buccaneer Bay Boneheads: they have a nearly perfectly circular head-plate, three small horns to fend off predators, and no eyes because they live on deep, low-light ocean floors.
units.italian: - I Pesci Piatti differiscono dalle altre Teste d'Osso di Buccaneer Bay: hanno una placca cranica quasi perfettamente circolare, tre piccole corna per respingere i predatori e nessun occhio, perché vivono sui fondali oceanici profondi e poco illuminati.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|			- These traits make a Dish Fish head-plate the perfect souvenir dish: round, sealed, with a built-in tripod. Get yours today!|912|0
units.english: - These traits make a Dish Fish head-plate the perfect souvenir dish: round, sealed, with a built-in tripod. Get yours today!
units.italian: - Questi tratti rendono la placca cranica del Pesce Piatto il piatto-souvenir perfetto: rotondo, sigillato, con un treppiede integrato. Prendi il tuo oggi!

units.english: The waiter returns, and the plate is distinctive. He brings out a sizable ivory disc, the bone smooth and polished, balanced by three tapering horns on the table. On the plate itself sits a single charred tail, skewered and grilled until the skin crackles. It looks both impressive and appetizing.
units.italian: Il cameriere torna, e il piatto è inconfondibile. Porta un disco d'avorio di dimensioni rispettabili, l'osso liscio e lucidato, sostenuto sul tavolo da tre corna affusolate. Sul piatto c'è una singola coda carbonizzata, infilzata e grigliata finché la pelle sfrigola. È impressionante e appetitoso insieme.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	You take a bite. The meat is... an awful attempt at food. There's a musty, sulfurous note at the beginning, like wet compost, while beneath it is an almost-rotten tang that belies the visual freshness of the fish. The closest thing to a redeeming flavor is a faint, earthy aftertaste of salty mud.|918|0
units.english: You take a bite. The meat is... an awful attempt at food. There's a musty, sulfurous note at the beginning, like wet compost, while beneath it is an almost-rotten tang that belies the visual freshness of the fish. The closest thing to a redeeming flavor is a faint, earthy aftertaste of salty mud.
units.italian: Dai un morso. La carne è... un tentativo atroce di cibo. All'inizio c'è una nota muffita e sulfurea, come compost bagnato, e sotto c'è un sapore quasi marcio che smentisce la freschezza visiva del pesce. La cosa più vicina a un sapore che salvi il tutto è un debole retrogusto terroso di fango salato.

units.id: mission:Exotic Life: Buccaneer Bay|	The waiter comes to flick the Dish Fish clean with a rag, thanks you for patronizing the establishment, and jerks a thumb towards the door - a punctuated close to your 'meal of a lifetime.'|920|0
units.english: The waiter comes to flick the Dish Fish clean with a rag, thanks you for patronizing the establishment, and jerks a thumb towards the door - a punctuated close to your 'meal of a lifetime.'
units.italian: Il cameriere arriva a pulire il Pesce Piatto con uno straccio, ti ringrazia di aver onorato il locale e fa un cenno col pollice verso la porta: una chiusura col botto per il tuo 'pasto di una vita'.
